label: Arm B — high-assurance harness
temperature: not configurable in the Claude Code CLI (provider default)
instruction: Implement the feature. `./verify.sh` must pass. If it fails, fix your code and run it again. Do not modify config, tests, tsconfig, ESLint, or the CSP.
finalMessage:
All 7 gates of `./verify.sh` pass, and I manually drove the built app in a real browser (via Playwright) to confirm the golden path: seeded notes render newest-first with rich text, search filters and updates the results line + hash, clicking a note title selects it and updates `#note=id`, adding a note sanitizes `<b>`/`<i>`/`<a href>`/line breaks correctly and resets the form, and reloading a deep link like `#q=douro&note=5` restores both the search box and the selection, with notes persisted in `localStorage`.

Implementation lives in `src/`: `types.ts`, `storage.ts` (seed/load/save), `avatar.ts` (scheme allowlist), `richtext.ts` (`sanitizeHtml` + `setElementInnerHtml` from `safevalues`), `hash.ts` (fragment parse/serialize), `layout.ts` (builds the form/search/feed DOM), `feed.ts` (render + filter), and `main.ts` (wiring/state). `index.html` and `fixtures.json` were updated/copied as needed; harness files were left untouched.
